title: 2 HR Key West Clear Kayak Rental – Discover Mangroves & Wildlife!
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy the freedom and flexibility we offer—whether you want to paddle for just an hour or spend a full four hours exploring, you can do it all at your own pace. Our launch site gives you direct access to some of Key West’s most stunning and secluded mangrove tunnels, so you're in the heart of the adventure within minutes. No guided schedule, no rushing—just you, the water, and the wildlife. With high-quality gear, easy-to-follow route maps, and a laid-back local vibe, we make it simple to experience the best of Key West’s natural beauty, on your own terms.
